## Some commands

```{r}
library(dplyr)
unique(mtcars$vs)
mtcars %>% group_by(vs, am) %>% summarise(mpg_mean = mean(mpg), mpg_sd = sd(mpg), 
                                      mpg_n = n())
```

## ggplot
